title: Footnotes with span fnref:id pattern
content:
The first technique relies on precise calibration.[^1]

The second technique uses iterative refinement.[^2]

Both approaches were validated experimentally.[^3]

[^1]: Calibration details are described in the reference manual.

[^2]: Iterative refinement was first proposed in 1985.

[^3]: Experimental validation was performed under controlled conditions.
